text.tspan: Death rates from different causes in the United States since 1900
Annual number of deaths per 100,000 people, based on the underlying cause listed on death certificates. This is
a crude rate, so it doesn’t account for the population getting older over time.

tspan.tspan: Before 1933, the data covers only the states that registered deaths. Revisions to the classification of causes of death create breaks in
